scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and independent finite-difference checks supplied. Prior fixed-site threshold formulas and distributed-reset first-passage methods credited; best-knowledge originality comparison is not an independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional bounded Dirichlet habitat; linear constant growth; independent spatial Poisson relocation; fixed fractional support, mean and variance. The threshold is a mean population spectral threshold, not almost-sure survival of a finite stochastic branching system. Universal claims proved analytically; finite numerical checks support but do not certify them.
title: A reset-rate phase reversal in variance-constrained critical habitat design
